summary: Australian Oilseeds Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting the October 12, 2026 completion of a private placement of 18,240,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.2193 per share, raising approximately US$4.0 million gross before expenses. Purchasers were non-U.S. persons under Regulation S; post-closing shares outstanding were 67,108,604. The company agreed to file a resale registration statement within 90 days. Proceeds fund business expansion, working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch resale-registration timing and any share overhang.
